note_why: Every footnote RBI prints, per table, with its handling (signals/README "RBI lending and deposit rates": footnotes are classified, not ignored). A note the file prints that is not listed here fails stage 1c, as an unclassified raw date does for SIBC.

kinds.provisional: RBI marks every value provisional; revisions are tracked by the release diff.
kinds.definition: How RBI computes the rate; no effect on reading it.
kinds.carried: Kept as context; does not break the series (a rate is a price, not a stock).
kinds.series_break: Coverage changes at `effective`: a 12-month change spanning it is excluded from the driver read and counted.

(ii) Data from July 2023 onwards include.why: The HDFC merger changes who is in the average, not what a rate measures; unlike a credit stock the level does not jump with the merger.

Note: Data pertains to Domestic Banks fo.why: Foreign banks enter the sector averages from Mar 2021.
Foreign banks enter the sector averages from May 2021.
